summary.text: Jonathan Bradner is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Cindy Abrams.
A pastor, he described himself in a Ballotpedia survey as a reconciling pastor and local advocate whose priorities include affordability, public school funding and housing costs.

paragraphs.text: Jonathan Bradner graduated from the United Theological Seminary of the Twin Cities in 2021 and has worked as a pastor.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised in Northwest Ohio, worked on a pig farm as a young person and later built a career in the hospitality industry that ended with the title Director of Operations and Marketing and Sales.
He said that in that career he advocated for fair wages for his co-workers, which guides his support for labor and union organizing.
Bradner said in the survey that his top priority is affordability, including property tax relief, capping corporate ownership of housing, and capping prescription drug costs.
He also called for fully funding public education and listed the Hamilton County Democratic Party as an endorser.
